pwsbuilder July 10, 2018

Meet the Artists Marion Harcourt and Carl Wood for a free demonstration at the Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists from 2 to 4 PM on Saturday, July 21.  Marion will create a watercolor of Herring River. Their work is on display at the gallery, open 7 days a week.

The Art Gallery (source page unavailable) is located at 551 Main Street (Rte. 28) in Harwich Port, (508) 432-1012. Free parking across the street at the Harwich Chamber of Commerce Visitors Information Center.
